jobs.title: Sales Account Executive, Pressable
jobs.description: Work With Us – Sales Account Executive, Pressable Skip to content Sales Account Executive, Pressable Pressable  (“WordPress hosting that means business”) seeks an experienced, motivated, and empathetic professional with the expertise to help us meet or exceed aggressive growth goals for our superb WordPress hosting company. Pressable is seeking an experienced, strategic, and consultative Sales Account Executive (SAE) to convert qualified prospects into customers through a consultative, solution-oriented sales approach. This role is responsible for managing opportunities from discovery through close, building strong customer relationships, and helping prospects select the right solution for their business needs. The SAE is a full-cycle seller focused on high-value new business opportunities across Pressable’s target market. You will work with both inbound and self-generated opportunities, run a disciplined sales process, and drive deals forward with strong discovery, solution alignment, and commercial execution. The role requires technical fluency, solid business judgment, and the ability to build trust with prospective customers while moving opportunities efficiently from initial engagement through close. The SAE role is intentionally structured to leverage AI as a force multiplier for research, preparation, and insight, while keeping human judgment, relationship-building, and decision-making at the center of the sales process. You will report to the Head of Sales & Enablement and work closely with Solutions, Support, and Product partners to ensure high-quality execution across strategic opportunities. This is a senior individual contributor role designed for someone who thrives in longer sales cycles, multi-stakeholder environments, and consultative selling motions. Responsibilities Strategic Deal Ownership Own the full sales process from initial customer engagement through close for mid-market and agency new business opportunities. Build relationships with prospective customers and understand their business needs, technical requirements, and growth goals. Conduct discovery calls, solution discussions, and presentations that clearly communicate the value of Pressable’s managed WordPress hosting platform. Recommend the right products, packages, and terms to set customers up for long-term success. Prepare proposals, pricing, and quotes that align with customer requirements and standard company guidelines. Manage follow-up, pipeline progression, and next steps consistently across the sales cycle. Drive new business through a mix of company-generated opportunities, outbound prospecting, and relationship-based selling. Pull in technical or leadership partners when needed to support the deal and ensure customer confidence. Handle commercial conversations confidently and partner internally on non-standard contract or custom-term negotiations as appropriate. Support onboarding and maintain customer relationships that create opportunities for retention, upsell, and cross-sell. Stay informed on market trends, competitive offerings, and customer pain points to improve effectiveness and win rates. Own an individual revenue quota across new logo acquisition and strategic expansion within larger agency and mid-market segments. Pipeline & Account Management Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, and deal documentation in HubSpot. Ensure opportunities are properly qualified, structured, and progressed with clear next steps. Identify expansion and long-term growth opportunities within high-value accounts. AI-Assisted Sales Execution Use AI tools to support account research, discovery preparation, deal analysis, and follow-up drafting. Leverage call transcripts and AI-generated insights to identify objections, patterns, and next steps. Apply judgment to AI outputs, knowing when to rely on automation and when human decision-making is required. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Solutions, Support, and Product teams to improve playbooks, pricing guidance, and feedback loops for strategic deals. Contribute structured product and market feedback based on real customer conversations. Requirements: 3+ years of SaaS sales experience; experience in hosting, infrastructure, WordPress, or adjacent technology categories is strongly preferred. Proven ability to manage opportunities through a full sales cycle and consistently hit or exceed targets. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical buyers. Consultative selling mindset with strong discovery, follow-up, and customer-facing problem-solving skills. Technical curiosity and enough fluency to confidently discuss managed hosting and related customer requirements. Strong organizational skills and a disciplined approach to pipeline management and execution. Ability to collaborate effectively with internal partners across sales, marketing, support, and technical teams. Results-driven, adaptable, and motivated by helping customers find the right solution. Strong judgment and prioritization skills in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot), and disciplined pipeline management. Comfort using AI-assisted sales tools to support research, preparation, follow-up, and deal analysis. Preferred Qualifications: Experience selling to agencies, developers, or infrastructure-aware customers. Experience working in sales environments that leverage AI for efficiency and insight. As a part of our fully distributed team, you can live in a wide range of locations around the world. Effectiveness in this role will mean occasionally shifting hours across weekends and odd hours to best coordinate with our global team. About Pressable Founded in 2010, Pressable is a world-class managed WordPress hosting provider that specializes in scalable, highly available services for agencies, builders, developers, and businesses. With industry-leading performance, 24/7 expert support, an award-winning control panel, advanced developer tools, and seamless integrations with  WooCommerce  and  Jetpack , Pressable provides the tools you need to reliably manage your WordPress websites with ease.    We are currently looking for candidates in Latin America and North America only. Salary range:   $90,000 – 125,000 USD OTE, with 60/40 commission split .  Please note that while salary ranges are presented here in USD, we will pay in local currency. We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated. Perks & Benefits of Joining Pressable! Health Benefits for US-based staff (99% Paid Employee Medical, Dental, and Vision). Matching 401(k) for US-based staff. Life and Disability Insurance for US-based staff (100% Paid Life & LTD). Work from home with a home office setup and coworking allowances. Open vacation policy (no set number of days per year). Hardware and software, books or conferences that promote continued learning. So, are you ready to embark on this thrilling WordPress adventure? We can’t wait to welcome you to the Pressable team and empower you to make the web a better place. Come join us in crafting an exceptional customer experience and revolutionizing the world of WordPress hosting. Apply now and let’s build something amazing together! As a government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA), we request this information in order to measure the effectiveness of the outreach and positive recruitment efforts we undertake pursuant to VEVRAA. Classification of protected categories is as follows: A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability. A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service. An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense. An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985. How do you know if you have a disability? A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability.
